name: FPE (Fundamental Paper Education) ecosystem
summary: Youth-heavy fandom ecosystem targeted by UTTP-linked activity. WIC documents an FPE incursion; WIC is not an FPE partner and does not govern the fandom.
current_state: Target ecosystem; WIC defence/reporting role only.

sources.name: UTTP archive — main repository
sources.use: Claims, tracking, source index, evidence standards

claims.claim: No evidence was located that UTTP is an operational arm of 764 or merged with 764.
claims.confidence: X for the positive claim; negative finding
claims.basis: Web search; designations; Sparx; Bx; community claims.

claims.claim: DPOS is best described as a hardcore UTTP offshoot/splinter, not a separate unrelated group.
The archived DPOS server contains 53 channel snapshots and ~3,205 messages from February–June 2025, with Empire/Task Force/ISA HQ/log structures.
claims.basis: Direct observation of exported Discord JSON.
claims.source: 04_OFFSHOOTS/DPOS - Degeneracy Police Order State/DPOS - EV 2025/DPOS Chat Leaks JSON/

claims.claim: DPOS and 764 overlap in grooming/blackmail/self-harm/shock-content tactics; no command or merger is established.
'O9A/09A is the parent entity and 764 is its operational arm'
claims.basis: The NZ statement lists 764 as an O9A nexion, but nexions are operationally independent; no parent/command relationship is established.

claims.claim: 'UTTP is an operational arm of 764' / 'UTTP merged with 764'
claims.basis: No command, merger, shared leadership, or tasking record located; both networks are decentralised.
The infiltration described by Sparx is by 'bad actors' in 2019-2021 and is O9A-adjacent; 764 emerged in 2021.
The raw file contains 823 rows, not 823 profiles; many are search, login, error, or duplicate pages.
The 22 are structural candidates, not ownership-confirmed accounts; 0 were ownership-verified in the 2026-11-19 pass.

claims.claim: '09A Cult is O9A's headquarters / the root of the hierarchy'
claims.basis: '09A Cult' is a legacy archive label; no headquarters is established.
764 is a designated, decentralised network; it is not a proven parent of UTTP.

claims.claim: '764 operatives infiltrated UTTP high command' / 'merger mid-to-late 2025'
claims.basis: WIC records describe alleged recruitment/overlap; no primary command, merger, or tasking record located.
Tactical/ideological overlap is supported; derivation/command is not. WIC language overstates the evidence.
No primary federal case, indictment, or designation naming DPOS was located.
third-party/DTAD count is not independently verified; counting method and unique-account threshold are not published.

claims.claim: 'The DPOS lead is 90% likely a 764 member/affiliate'
claims.basis: Behavioural/tactical overlap is not membership proof; the 90% figure has no published method.
DPOS is an offshoot/overlap node, not identical to UTTP or 764.
